title: Chapter 146: Absolute Shadow
content:
Chapter 146: Absolute Shadow

In the hall, two groups of people were confronting each other faintly, and the atmosphere of tension spread. The cold weather in the whole hall became even more bone-chilling.

"Zhang Fei from Yan, you are from the country of Yan, how dare you disobey my order, are you not afraid of implicating your family?" Sitting on his seat, Lord Yanchun tightly held the handle, his knuckles creaking .

"Hey, I'm from Yan. I mean people from the country of Yan. I'm not a citizen of your country of Yan? You seem to be a little self-indulgent. As for the uncle, my family is no longer in the country of Yan. What about you? How about getting involved?" Zhang Fei sneered a few times, disdainful.

"Damn it, Jueying, what are you waiting for? Why don't you kill them quickly? You also go to me!" After Zhang Fei's disdainful tone came, Yanchun Jun ordered to Jueying, and ordered those around him Soldiers, let's go together.

"Haha, come on, I've been waiting for you for a long time!" Zhang Fei laughed a few times, waved the Zhangba Snake Spear in his hand, and killed the soldiers who rushed over.

"Yide, wait for me, be careful of falling into the enemy's siege!" Zhao Zilong who was beside Zhang Fei yelled, and quickly followed with his silver gun.

Between the lights of swords and the shadows of swords, blood continued to emerge, and one after another soldiers fell to the ground under the bravery of Zhao Yun and the two, turning into dead bones.

The two of them rampaged all the way, as if entering no one's land, among them, they were brave, only to see the complexion of everyone in the hall change, and their hearts were unbearably horrified.

"Quick, stop them quickly, you guys will do it too!" Jun Yanchun said to the guards around him with a flustered expression as he watched the two men approaching him, getting closer and closer to him.

"Yes!" Several guards around looked at each other and shouted resolutely.

"Rebel, Hugh is rampant!"

As the guards shouted in unison, all the guards surged up, wrapped Zhang Fei, and stopped his progress immediately, as if he would be drowned in the crowd.

"Yide, I'll help you!" Ever since seeing that Zhang Fei seemed to be in danger, he was very anxious and ran towards Zhang Fei.

"Hey, your opponent is me. If you want to help others, you should look at yourself first!" Jueying sneered a few times, and was scared away by these two people just now, which made him feel extremely proud and confident in his heart. Ashamed. Seeing that there is only one person in front of him at this moment, how could he let this opportunity go, and hurriedly greeted him.

"Damn it, since you want to seek death, I'll make it happen for you!" Seeing that the way in front of him was blocked, Zhao Yun cursed coldly, feeling extremely upset, and directly displayed his stunt.

‘A hundred birds chasing the phoenix? '

Jueying watched the gun shadow in front of him continue to shake, and suddenly thousands of light spots were lit up, forming the shapes of flying birds, and finally the figure of a phoenix, with traces of fire, Like a phoenix bathing in flames, it slammed into itself.

"Damn it, don't underestimate me, I'm also a top-notch expert, how can I be like this!" roared a few times, Jueying swung the long sword in his hand, emitting streaks of golden light, extremely sharp, and stabbed at the phoenix in front of him.

"Squeaky, clang!"

The sound of weapons colliding could be heard endlessly. In the blink of an eye, the two had exchanged hundreds of moves, and there were bursts of crisp metal sounds, which were pleasant to the ear, but hidden behind them were infinite murderous intentions.

After a long time, and it seemed to be very fast, the fight between the two stopped, each holding their chests and panting heavily, their bodies supported by their respective weapons, looking extremely tired, with scars and blood dripping on their bodies. Bobo down.

"Hey, although you are very strong, you have a weakness?" Jueying laughed a few times, extremely proud.

"Although I have a weakness, you also have a disadvantage. How much can you laugh?" Zhao Yun replied unwillingly.

Looking at the two of them, they saw that the silver spear Zhao Yun was holding was shaking violently a few times, and with a plop, it broke into two sections, and the upper part of the gun fell completely from Zhao Yun's hand.

And Jueying, the clothes that were originally very neat when he was alive, turned into a little smoke and dust with a bang, and drifted away with the wind, revealing his blood-stained body, with streaks of blood emerging, which was extremely frightening.

"I didn't expect that, as a first-class master, you don't have a first-class sword that matches you?" Sighed a few times, as if he felt that he was the master of the person in front of him, and felt that his eyes did not recognize heroes.

"I didn't expect that you, as a secret assassin, would be sent by your master to fight the enemy with open guns and swords. What a pity for your profession!" Zhao Yun also sighed a few times.

This is how things are in the world, there are few things that are perfect and have no regrets. The two people in front of them, as masters, also have their own flaws or regrets.

"However, Zilong will soon have no regrets. On the contrary, if you can surrender, you can still save your life, otherwise..." Behind him, Zhong Yu knelt down and said these words.

Jueying turned back in response, and saw the purple-robed man, looking calmly at the place where the two of them were standing, the cold and ruthless gaze pierced his heart, causing his already perfected state of mind to shudder for a while. rise together.

"Where is my tiger idiot? Take this man with me, and hand over his sword to Zilong to repay his regret. If there is any resistance, I will kill him!" With a loud shout, Zhong Yu said to Xu Chu.

"The last general is ordered to take down this dog, and to live up to the grace!" Xu Chu responded, then raised the big knife in his hand, and walked towards Jue Ying in front of him.

Jueying looked at Xu Chu in front of him and walked towards him, his complexion changed even more.

Damn it, when did this little Feixue Pavilion have so many experts. In the rivers and lakes, it is usually difficult to find a first-class one, but today there are so many. And what's even more unbelievable is that they are still under the same command. What is the identity of this purple-robed man in front of him?

He clenched his Juying Sword tightly in his hand. He was originally a famous swordsman in the Jianghu.

In the entire south of the Yan Kingdom, he defeated countless opponents and became the strongest of the younger generation. Then he came to the capital of the Yan Kingdom, trying to defeat more outstanding talents of the Yan Kingdom, but his own strength went even further.

However, in the capital, although he defeated some famous swordsmen, he found that these people were mediocre, and it was difficult for him to make further progress.

Then, with an inflated heart, he violated a taboo that could not be violated, and caused a catastrophe. It was Lord Yanchun, who used his incomparable power in the country of Yan to save himself and bestowed upon him the Absolute Shadow Sword.

Let myself rely on this sword to break through the first-class strength, and I also lost my name, leaving only the name of Jueying to be called by others.

Now, I also want to use this sword to defeat the enemy in front of me and let myself make another breakthrough.

In the hall, the fighting spirit was burning.
